__note: Launch conditions no tool can verify. scripts/neoh-launch-readiness.py reports each one: an open 'blocker' is BLOCKED, an open 'warning' is WARN. Close one by setting status to "done" and adding evidence (who, when, where) in the same commit. Sources: docs/subprocessor-inventory.md, docs/privacy-data-map.md, docs/privacy-counsel-checklist.md, docs/resilience-drill-report.md, docs/security-launch-gate.json.

gates.title: Email sent through a provider with a DPA
gates.how_to_close: replace consumer Gmail SMTP with Google Workspace (DPA) or a transactional email provider; set ORACLE_SMTP_* on the production app (docs/subprocessor-inventory.md item 1)

gates.title: Realtime voice model not processing in Singapore undisclosed
gates.how_to_close: re-region DashScope to the US, or keep Qwen realtime disabled (no DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in production), or disclose Singapore processing to brokerages (docs/subprocessor-inventory.md item 2)

gates.title: Counsel sign-off: DPAs, subprocessor list, plaintext PII accepted or remediated
gates.how_to_close: counsel completes docs/privacy-counsel-checklist.md, confirms each DPA (DigitalOcean, Twilio, Fireworks, Plivo, Telnyx, RunPod) and accepts or rejects the plaintext PII columns in docs/privacy-data-map.md

gates.title: Erasure owner can see every row under FORCE RLS on DigitalOcean
gates.how_to_close: confirm the SECURITY DEFINER erasure owner (the migration role) is BYPASSRLS or every erasable table has a platform DELETE+SELECT policy, so an erasure cannot silently delete 0 rows and report clean
gates.evidence: 2026-10-03, lead, on neoh-postgres-staging: doadmin (the migration role, owner of the DEFINER functions) has BYPASSRLS=true and is not superuser; oracle_app_login (doctl-created) has no superuser/BYPASSRLS/CREATEROLE/CREATEDB. Condition: doadmin only ever runs migrations, never the app.

gates.title: Live erasure test run against the DigitalOcean cluster
gates.how_to_close: run backend/tests/test_privacy_lifecycle_live.py and tests/privacy_lifecycle.sql against neoh-postgres-staging (throwaway tenant) and record the result in docs/launch-state.md

gates.title: ElevenLabs training opt-out (only if ElevenLabs is enabled)
gates.how_to_close: ElevenLabs is not in the production spec; before adding its key, opt out of training on the account (docs/subprocessor-inventory.md item 3)

gates.title: Failure drills re-run on DigitalOcean staging and provider sandboxes
gates.how_to_close: run performance/resilience/run_drill.sh (db_stop, valkey, worker kill, AI 429/hang, MLS 401/503) against neoh-staging and the providers' test/sandbox modes; record results in docs/resilience-drill-report.md

gates.title: DigitalOcean spend alerts configured
gates.how_to_close: Billing -> Spend Alerts in the DigitalOcean console (email notification, not a cap)

gates.title: Support email and urgent route decided
gates.how_to_close: the owner fills the placeholders in docs/support-model.md (support address, urgent phone/route, who is on point)
